glass.label: VGlass
glass.description: Draw notifications as frosted glass with a moving edge light.
glass.info: VGlass in Appearance, Windows can turn glass on or off for every glass surface. This switch then has no effect.

slackPhotos.label: Slack photos
slackPhotos.description: Show sender photos from your Slack workspace.
slackPhotos.info: Set up Slack photos opens Slack app creation with the app details filled. Sign in if asked. Select your workspace. Review the permissions. Create and install the app. Allow access. Copy its User OAuth Token. Sign in to the workspace in the Slack desktop app. Under Setup, select Add key and paste the token into the masked field. This adds photos, workspace icons and custom emoji.

duration.label: Notification duration
duration.description: Set the minimum time for normal notifications.

customEmoji.label: Slack custom emoji
customEmoji.description: Show custom emoji in Slack notifications.

slackTokens.label: Slack tokens
slackTokens.hint: Connect each workspace to show sender photos.
slackTokens.info: Select Set up Slack photos to open Slack app creation with the app details filled. Complete the workspace and access steps. Then connect each workspace with its User OAuth Token. VGS stores the token in your keyring. The token adds sender photos, workspace icons and custom emoji.

notification.label: New notification
notification.description: Plays when a notification shows on screen. Sound off and Do Not Disturb also mute an app's own notification sound, not its calls or media.

binds.info: Opens the list of notifications you have not cleared, or closes it.
